meta.title: DataSift Doors Per Deal

ftm_types.label: Foreclosure notices
ftm_types.win: days 1-30 from notice filing, before the auction
ftm_types.cad: pull daily to weekly (fast in nonjudicial states)

ftm_types.label: Tax sale list
ftm_types.win: 60-90 days before the auction, once the list publishes
ftm_types.cad: annual list, published as legal notices 3-4 weeks pre-sale

ftm_types.label: Tax delinquent roll
ftm_types.win: ongoing: bills owed but no auction date yet

ftm_types.label: Probate filings
ftm_types.win: 30-180 days from filing; contact the personal representative, never the deceased
ftm_types.cad: pull daily to weekly from the court

ftm_types.label: Eviction filings
ftm_types.win: immediate: the landlord (plaintiff) is motivated now; 2+ filings in 12 months = tired landlord
ftm_types.cad: pull weekly from the court docket

ftm_types.label: Code violations
ftm_types.win: before the compliance deadline, typically 10-30 days
ftm_types.cad: weekly to monthly; usually CITY-level, often a records request

ftm_types.label: Divorce filings
ftm_types.win: 60-180 days from filing; property sits on the marital asset schedule
ftm_types.cad: pull weekly; lowest competition of the seven

meta.verify_rule: v2.1 coverage-aware: verify reasons annotate (churn: doors/deal < 5; small: list < 250) without demoting; only judicial notice lists and churn artifacts (doors/deal < 1) force P3. Volume floors: P1 needs >=2% of county deal flow or >=25 deals, P2 >=1% or >=12 deals

detail.name: Professional
detail.blurb: 3 users, 10k monthly records, outbound marketing. Pulls every All plans row: equity, absentee, free and clear, and vacant (via the Vacant quick preset).

detail.name: Business
detail.blurb: 5 users, 25k records, inbound + outbound, unlimited sequences. Same data access as Professional.

detail.name: Expert
detail.blurb: 15 users, 50k records, SiftMap Pro and unlimited skip tracing included. Pulls every list and stack on this page except the AI Score rows.

detail.name: AI
detail.blurb: Everything in Expert plus Investor AI Score off-market (1 county included). Pulls the AI Score rows.

plans.addon: On Professional or Business, the Pro data rows unlock with the SiftMap Pro add-on (+$297/mo) instead of a full upgrade.
